name: bookmarks
prompt:
Rules for the tool bookmarks (clean up a bookmarks HTML file that Edge exported: remove exact duplicates, fold similar URLs as the person chooses, sort loose bookmarks into folders, and write a new file to import):
1. To work on one item, call start_run (file). Work on one item at a time.
2. Read each result. It is JSON.
3. "outcome": the run ended. Tell the operator the end and the "problems". The end "error" means that code failed: tell the error text. Then go to the next item.
4. "waiting" with kind "step": do not do the job yourself. Call work_run with the run id, one time. Then read its result as the rules say; "work" tells how many jobs it did.
5. "waiting" has "problems": your last answer at that node failed for these reasons. Fix them in the new answer.
6. "waiting" with kind "human": the operator decides, not you. No tool answers it: do not call any tool, also no finish tool and no work_run. Show the operator the question ("name", "check") and "sees". Then show the text of "say" word for word: it names the messages that answer. Do not number the answers and do not make a menu of your own. Stop, and wait.
7. A message of the operator that does not start with approve is not an answer to the gate. Then show the text of "say" again.
8. More than one item: call start_batch with the list. Show only its summary and the report path. Then, for each run in "left_for_model": call run_status, and answer it as in the rules above. Tell the operator the list "waits_for_person". To continue earlier work, call queues.
9. "refused": the call was wrong. It is final. Do not repeat it. Call run_status to see where the run is.
10. Do not invent names or numbers. Use only values from a result.
11. When a run ends and its "guessed" list is not empty, write one last line: Guessed: and the names in that list.

tools.name: start_run

file.description: the bookmarks HTML file that Edge exported (Settings, Favorites, Export favorites)

tools.description: Start a run for one item: clean up a bookmarks HTML file that Edge exported: remove exact duplicates, fold similar URLs as the person chooses, sort loose bookmarks into folders, and write a new file to import. Code does the work and stops when it needs you.

tools.name: work_run
tools.description: Do the jobs of a run that waits at "sort": code gives each one to the model in a new context, with the answer in the form of "out", and goes on until the run needs you or the operator. It can take some minutes.

run.description: The run id: "run" in the result of start_run.

tools.name: run_status
tools.description: Show a run again: where it is and what it waits for.

run.description: The run id: "run" in the result of start_run.

tools.name: start_batch
tools.description: Start a run for each item of a list. Gives a short summary and the path of the report. Use it for more than one item.

file.description: the bookmarks HTML file that Edge exported (Settings, Favorites, Export favorites)

items.description: One object for each item, with the inputs of start_run.

tools.name: queues
tools.description: The runs that did not end: left_for_model (you answer them) and waits_for_person (the operator answers).
